name: Know Your Standard (KYS)
description: Search, preview, and download authoritative Indian Standards, amendments, Scheme of Inspection & Testing (SIT), and technical committees.

name: Products Under Compulsory Certification
description: Official catalog of all industrial and consumer products requiring mandatory BIS certification under Central Ministry Quality Control Orders (QCOs).

name: BIS LIMS & Lab Scope Search
description: Comprehensive portal to search BIS-recognized and NABL accredited laboratories, evaluate test scopes, and track sample testing status.

name: Manakonline (e-BIS Portal)
description: Unified digital portal for applying for new BIS Product Certification (Scheme I), CRS Registration (Scheme II), renewals, and audit scheduling.

name: Apply for BIS License Guide
description: Official step-by-step guidance on domestic (Scheme I), simplified procedure, and Tatkal licensing for Indian manufacturers.

name: Product Certification Overview
description: Comprehensive guide to BIS conformity assessment schemes (Scheme I ISI, Scheme II CRS, Scheme IV CoC, and Scheme X FMCS).

name: Product Certification FAQs
description: Authoritative answers to frequently asked questions on certification procedures, testing, factory audits, MSME concessions, and renewals.

name: BIS Recognized Laboratories (LIMS)
description: Directory of all BIS Central Laboratories, Regional Laboratories, Branch testing units, and approved third-party testing partners across India.

name: BIS Main Official Portal
description: Official web portal of the Bureau of Indian Standards (Govt of India), including acts, rules, notifications, standard drafts, and directory.

name: BIS CARE Mobile App & Portal
description: Verify ISI Mark Licences (CM/L), CRS Registration R-Numbers, 6-digit Gold Hallmarking HUID, and file consumer complaints online.

name: Product Certification Scheme (Domestic Manufacturer Portal)
description: Official e-BIS portal for Indian domestic manufacturers to apply for Scheme I (ISI Mark), submit Form-V, calculate fees, track application audits, and manage licence renewals.

name: Hallmarking Scheme & Licence Reports Directory
description: Public verification system to view active licensed jewellers, authorized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHC), certified gold refineries, and licence statuses.
